documents.origin_title: Solving Character and Asset Consistency in Generative AI Production Pipelines
documents.summary: Owner-run deep-research report on keeping characters, wardrobe and props consistent across generated images: weight-space tuning (Textual Inversion, DreamBooth, LoRA) against zero-shot adapters (IP-Adapter, InstantID, PhotoMaker, PuLID, Arc2Face, FLUX Kontext) and their measured limits (head pose, VAE scale, expression); wardrobe and prop locks (virtual try-on, ControlNet, regional conditioning); the asset-bible workflow (2K casting, 6-card set, turnaround audit, seeds and samplers); cross-model and multi-turn drift; an upstream declarative character registry with compile-time token resolution; three automated drift gates (face embedding, DINOv2 and CLIP-T, VLM-as-judge) and a six-phase SOP. Reviewed in full 2026-10-17. Works cited: 39 primary (arXiv, CVPR, NeurIPS) and 121 web (blogs, forums, vendor docs); many numeric thresholds rest on single blog posts and stay unchecked until verified.

documents.origin_title: Continuity norms and structures: landscape for a layperson's LLM-agnostic tool
documents.summary: A deep-research prompt asking for the established continuity structures of film, animation, comics and games (what they are called, what fields they hold, who maintains them, where they fail), the AI-era equivalents, and the gaps left for a non-technical person who tells stories through a browser chatbot with no API, so that a simple, LLM-agnostic continuity card and shot sheet can be designed on top of real norms rather than invented ones. Not yet run.
